messages:
maria: Quick ask — QuantumEdge (large analytics customer) is pushing for a bespoke price for a 3‑month POC that could convert to Dedicated. They want 35% off list for hosted API usage plus a 6‑GPU Dedicated pilot. Can we get an exception?
ben: Can you share expected token/month and target latency? 35% is pretty deep. Also which Dedicated sku (A100/RTX) and whether they need isolation?
maria: They're estimating ~1.2B tokens/month during POC (spiky). Latency target: <150ms p95. Dedicated ask: 6x A100-ish equiv for the pilot, then scale to a reserve of 20 gpus if conversion.
emily: FYI they need SOC2 evidence and enterprise SSO — that's already in our checklist. POC timeline wants quick start in 2 weeks.
caroline: Discount policy reminder: standard cap for mid-market POC is 25% unless deal desk approves. Also need committed MRR/TCV figure to model revenue/regressions.
dave: 35% could be approved only if there's a financial commitment or escalation path. What's the committed ARR if they convert? Also need margin impact and whether partner credits apply.
maria: They sign up for a 3mo POC with an option to convert to 12mo reserved commit. If converted, they expect ~$1.05M ARR equivalent (monthly burn ~87.5k). For POC they want no upfront commit; just pay-as-you-go but at the discounted rate.
dave: No-commit POC + 35% off on hosted + reserved pilot is risky. We can consider a staged concession: 25% off hosted for POC + refundable pilot deposit (covers 2 weeks of Dedicated) and escalation to 30% if they convert to 12mo commit within 60 days. Need numbers in a short model.
ben: Quick cost sketch (very rough):
```
List hosted e2e cost @ current profile: ~$0.30 per 1k tokens -> monthly 360k USD
Dedicated pilot op cost (6x A100 equiv) -> infra cost ~45k/mo -> markup -> price to customer ~85k/mo
If we give 25% off hosted + pilot deposit, net goes to ~270k + pilot deposit
```
maria: They pushed back on deposits but are open to conversion-based uplift. Chief procurement said they'd only sign if POC pricing is "very friendly".
emily: We should protect our unit economics. Can we offer a limited promo: 30% off hosted tokens for the first 3 months capped at X tokens, and a pilot credit equivalence rather than refundable deposit? That keeps them feeling supported.
dave: I can approve a 30% one-time promotional credit for up to $75k against hosted usage for the POC if SalesOps signs new T&Cs: conversion clause, rollback pricing, and a committed conversion SLO. No blanket 35% recurring off list.
caroline: To operationalize: I need the exact promo amount, legal clause text, and the expected conversion window. If we do $75k promo + 30% off up to cap, SalesOps will need sign-off from revenue ops for recognition.
maria: OK — propose: 30% off hosted usage for 90 days or $75k cap (whichever hits first), pilot Dedicated billed at list but defer first 2 weeks invoice as a "pilot credit" applied if they convert within 45 days. If they don't convert, charge billed amount. Conversion triggers 30% discount for first 3 months of reserved commit and then standard enterprise tier.
dave: That seems acceptable. Please add the margin calc and final T&Cs. I will escalate if RevenueOps flags anything.
deal-desk-bot: New approval ticket created: DD-7890 — QuantumEdge POC promo request (30% promo cap $75k)
caroline: I'll draft the quote and updated T&Cs and post back here. ETA 24h.
maria: Thanks — I'll brief the buyer and ask procurement to accept the conversion SLO.
emily: I'll prep the SOC2/SAML materials so we can enable SSO quickly once legal sign-off exists.
ben: FYI for infra planning — if they hit spike profile we should pre-warm the node pool. I'll send a short runbook.
maria: Great — keeping this thread for final approval. Will ping when buyer signs LOI. :thumbsup:
